note: Fixture routing identifiers for source recognition. Domains are not statements about current availability, and an entry is not permission to acquire any work. Reference records come from the PirateBot catalog (data/sites.jsonl).

sources.name: YTS
sources.identity_caveat: yts.mx and yts.bz come from separate dated reports; neither is asserted to be the current entry point, so both resolve to this one record. The original YIFY/YTS group is a distinct historical identity.
sources.limitation: Identity only. Media Intake has no search or detail parser for this source; magnet and .torrent items attributed to it use the existing torrent and external download manager queue.
